name: Herbert Franco
headline: President, Chief Executive Officer & Principal Consultant - Cloud ⬩ Netsuite ⬩ ERP ⬩ Salesforce ⬩ CRM ⬩ Celigo ⬩ Integration
position: President, Executive Director and Principal Consultant
about:
We are Rainbow8Lion, and we have two exciting updates to share:
Our office is now located on the stunning Fisher Island in Miami Beach—you’re welcome to come visit us.
We are thrilled to announce that we are the newest Oracle Alliance Partner.
⬩ Our Mission: We excel in helping you optimize your business’s financial outcomes with innovative cloud solutions.
⬩ What We Do: We bring the agility of rainbows and the courage of lions to optimize your financials.
⬩ No Risk: We quantify your ROI before the project even begins.
⬩ Our Expertise: NetSuite | Salesforce | Celigo | Boomi | OnTrackPM | SuiteApps | R8L Light CRM | Zoho Expense | QuickBooks | R8L Business Methodology
⬩ Speed: Go live on NetSuite in 5 working days.
⬩ Learn With Us: Choose hands-on implementation or join our team for an educational experience.
⬩ Team Power: A dedicated team of 10 highly skilled professionals working 24/7 to deliver your IT projects.
⬩ Services: Process review & automation | Software review & selection | Salesforce Sales Cloud & Pardot | NetSuite | Warehouse Distribution WD | Manufacturing | Software | Services | Financials First | OneWorld | Multi-Book | NSPB/PBCS | Localization | SuiteBilling | QuickBooks | Expense management via Zoho Expense.
⬩ Development: Expert-level JavaScript development.
⬩ Integration: Powered by Celigo for seamless solutions.
⬩ Leadership: R8L Business Methodology: Human Resources | Customer Service | Leadership | Internal Process Review | Products and Services Offering Review | Automations | Financials | Equity | Cash Flow | Preparing your business for your growth cycle.
⬩ Implementation: We guide you through every phase of software implementation. Ask about our R8L Business Methodology—our guidance includes: Requirements Gathering | Documentation | Data Analysis | Configuration | Customization | Validation | Migration | Integration | Testing | Post Go-Live Support.
⬩ Infrastructure & IT Consulting: Expert advice on IT licenses, inventory management, and IT contracts.
Let’s transform your business together—visit us at our Fisher Island office or connect with us via a Google Meeting session and discover how Rainbow8Lion can drive your financial success!
